overrides.text: Inspiring Presence
All units gain +2 [Charge Bonus]
Example Custom Bonus
Edric the Unyielding
A banner-captain who has never once ordered a retreat.
不屈者埃德里克
The Lost Caravan
A merchant caravan has taken a wrong turn into bandit country. Its master waves you down, sweating through his silks.
Escort Them Out
Walk them back to the road and keep the bandits off.
Not a bandit dares show its face. The master pays you and throws in something from his wagon.
The bandits watch you pass and think better of it. The master pays as promised.
The bandits strike at the ford. You save the wagons, but not without cuts and bruises.
An ambush in the narrows. The caravan gets away while your warband takes the beating.
Buy His Spare Horses
He has more horses than wagons left to pull.
Fresh horses and a night's rest. Your warband rides into the next fight in high spirits.
Scout the Ridge
Send your marksmen up high to spot the bandits first.
From the ridge you see the whole road ahead, and an old watchtower you can hold in your next battle.
From the ridge you can see the whole road ahead, bandits and all.
Fog rolls over the ridge. Your scouts come back with nothing to report.
The bandits spot your scouts first and spread the word. Your next enemy marches in bold.
Wish Him Luck
Bandit country is not your problem.
As you leave, you hear him start haggling with the bandits.
